parameters.name: Accessibility
parameters.description:
The image visibility. Valid values:
- Public: visible to all users.
- Private: visible only to the creator.

parameters.name: AcrAssociatedVpcId
parameters.description: The VPC ID associated with the ACR instance. This parameter is required when referencing an ACR image.

parameters.name: AcrInstanceId
parameters.description: The ACR instance ID. This parameter is required when referencing an ACR image.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The image description, up to 128 characters.

parameters.name: EnableSyncMaxCompute
parameters.description: Specifies whether to synchronize the image to MaxCompute. Specify this parameter when referencing an ACR image. Default value: false.

parameters.name: ImageUri
parameters.description: The image URI. This parameter is required when referencing an ACR image.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The image name, which can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_), up to 128 characters.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The image namespace. Set this parameter to DataWorks Default when referencing a DataWorks official image.

parameters.name: ProviderImageId
parameters.description: The image ID from the image provider. This parameter is required when referencing a DataWorks official image.

parameters.name: ProviderType
parameters.description:
The image reference data type. Valid values:

- ACR: ACR image repository.
- DataWorks: DataWorks official image.

parameters.name: RepositoryName
parameters.description: The image repository name. Set this parameter to DataWorks Default when referencing a DataWorks official image.
